name: cosmos-v2
description: Cosmos is a multi-tenant project- and program-management platform (boards, OKRs, RAID logs, dependency mapping, SAFe program increments, an agentic in-app AI assistant, and a feedback portal) built on Next.js 16, React 19, and Prisma 7 / PostgreSQL with pgvector and fully offline in-process sentence embeddings. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
